notes.title: A Open Discussion about The Suits Have Gone Mad
notes.content:
Hey everyone. It’s been over a year since the first chapter of The Suits Have Gone Mad was released and I thought I’d share my thoughts about how I want to continue the game. Feel free to leave your opinions or thoughts too.


[h2][b]The issues with chapter-based releases[/b][/h2]

Chapter-based releases are a concept not unfamiliar to the indie scene. Many games have been very successful using this structure for releases. It allows a dev space to breathe and learn from the previous chapter to improve for the next.

[i]However, this release structure has glaring issues…[/i]

[b]Delays between each chapter.[/b] Long delays damage the hype of a release and raise expectations the longer it takes.

[b]Judging the experience as separate pieces.[/b] Each chapter tends to be viewed as an individual experience from the last. I want TSHGM to be a singular whole experience without the idea that each chapter should be better and bigger than the previous one.

[b]Linearity.[/b] This is the biggest issue in my opinion. The first chapter of TSHGM is an extremely linear experience. I want the full game to stray away from that ‘on-rails’ feel. The current idea is to encourage freedom of exploration by creating a set of objectives that can be tackled in the player's chosen order where they will have to explore the offices to discover how to complete each objective.

This means that TSHGM will most likely not be released in a chapter-based form. Instead, it will be released as a singular full experience.


[h2][b]The gameplay loop[/b][/h2]

There is no apparent gameplay loop in the first chapter. The slight smidge of a possible loop is in one of the final sections of the chapter in which you have to dodge the suits while waiting for an elevator.

This was intended to be extended into a system where you have to survive for a certain amount of time in an enclosed area while suits chase you around. From testing, I’m still not entirely convinced that it is a viable loop. I’ll need to do more testing. The current idea I have is a [b]sneak, run, search[/b] loop.

[b]Sneak.[/b] Stealthily moving around the office undetected while suits patrol. If the player is spotted, we enter the run stage.

[b]Run.[/b] The player has to run away from suits until they are out of a certain range, similar to the chase sequence in the first chapter. The hidden stage is entered once the player is out of range of any pursuing suits.

[b]Search.[/b] Suits will investigate the area where the player was last seen. This downtime will allow the player to explore other areas without needing to sneak around.

This system will need to be tested and balanced to feel fair, but I feel it will work well within the setting.


[h2][b]Is TSHGM a horror?[/b][/h2]

The term horror is a bit subjective and I’m undecided whether I should be classing the game as a ‘horror’. The game feels like an in-between of a horror game and an action game. It feels best to call it a thriller. 

But does labeling it as a horror drive away those that believe that it will be too scary of a game to try? Will horror enthusiasts say that it fails as a horror as they expected it to be extremely scary? This is still a decision I’m yet to decide on. I don’t want to unnecessarily cram in horror sections for the sake of keeping the horror label on it.


I haven’t begun working on TSHGM yet. But just wanted to share my current feelings about it. I’m very passionate about the project and want to achieve its vision. Let me know what you all think and sorry if I’m rambling on too much.


Cheers,
Blnk Dev

notes.title: The Suits Have Gone Mad! - Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
What's going on everyone!

[b]The Suits Have Gone Mad! has now been updated to version 1.1.0[/b]

Changes and additions listed below:
[list]
[*]Blake & Whitley Innovations are dedicated to embracing festivities and cultural events. The office has been allowed one carved pumpkin to decorate for Halloween!
[*]The elevator music has been changed.
[*]The engine version has been updated to a more stable version. This should hopefully resolve most of the issues that people have been experiencing.
[*]The file structure of the game has been completely changed to accommodate the DLC release structure. This means that the update will reinstall the majority of files, causing a large update size.
[*]A new main menu screen for Chapter 2 has been added.
[*]The overall graphical fidelity has been improved.
[*]Many, many, many under the hood changes to improve the quality of life.
[*]AI changes. Due to this, the chase sequence is easier now.
[*]Squashin' bugs.
[/list]

Chapter 2 is slowly progressing. It's an ambitious project that is proving to be difficult to complete as a solo dev. Nevertheless, I am continually working away at it. Here's a lil teaser screenshot for ya guys too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42844203/bbbb08cbe702dd6ed6c4eeed0248cdf87b3970e4.png[/img]

If you haven't yet, wishlist Chapter 2 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2461180/The_Suits_Have_Gone_Mad__The_Upper_Class/]HERE[/url]!

Cheers,
BlnkDev

notes.title: The Future for The Suits Have Gone Mad...
notes.content:
What's going on everyone? Hope I didn't scare ya with the announcement title! Development is still well and truly trucking along.

I figured I should answer some common questions about the future of The Suits Have Gone Mad! 

Check them out below:

[list]
[*][u][b]When will Chapter 2 release?[/b][/u]

Currently, I work on the game in my spare time. Because of this, the availability of when I can do work is extremely varied. [b]It makes it very difficult to set a deadline for Chapter 2[/b]. As I want to make this chapter as good as it can be, I prefer to take my time perfecting the game rather than rushing to meet a deadline. While this may leave a large lull in content for TSHGM, [b]I really want to make sure this game is great.[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*][u][b]How will the chapters be delivered?[/b][/u]

I was initially intending to release each chapter separately on Steam. I've decided to change it to a DLC approach. [b]Each chapter will be released as downloadable content for the currently released game on Steam.[/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*][u][b]Will the following chapters cost?[/b][/u]

As much as I'd love to release every chapter for free, I am wanting to make a transition into full-time game development. [b]This means that the following chapters will be paid DLC.[/b] A price has not been decided yet. What I can say is that the next chapter will most likely be [b]within the price range of $5-10 USD[/b]. Subsequent chapters will be longer than Chapter 1.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u][b]How many chapters will there be?[/b][/u]

The outline of the plot has been fully written. [b]It is looking to be a total of 4 chapters[/b]. I do not want to drag the story on for too long, as I have many more game ideas I would like to pursue.
[/list]
Thanks for giving this a read. You can catch glimpses of progress on my [url=https://twitter.com/BlnkDrmStudios]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: The Suits Have Gone Mad! - Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hey all,

Another tiny update. Just aiming to fix the little parts that people are struggling with.

[list]
[*]The second Suit that breaks through the window will now occur after the elevator doors open.
[*]The Suits that can be tripped on in the chase sequence stick out of their doors less.
[*]The encounter in Parlov's office has a couple bugs/softlock issues fixed.
[/list]

Cheers!

Side note: Development has already begun on the 2nd chapter. Catch any previews and teasers on my [url=https://twitter.com/BlnkDrmStudios]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: The Suits Have Gone Mad! - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hey all,

Releasing a minor update to the game. Details listed below:

[list]
[*]The introduction of the dodge mechanic has been modified to be more intuitive.
[*]The skip button has been made more obvious when doing the hacking puzzle.
[*]Fixed a bug which made the Suits in the dodge sequence get up incredibly quickly on occasion.
[*]Various, less obvious bugs have been squashed.
[/list]

Thank you so much to all that have played the game so far. I've been taken aback with how well this game has been received. The reception of the first chapter has been incredible and it has 100% motivated me to continue!

Side note: Development has already begun on the 2nd chapter. Catch any previews and teasers on my [url=https://twitter.com/BlnkDrmStudios]Twitter[/url].
